# Weekly Operations Report 12

## Operations

The Rover Operations Control Centre (ROCC) commanded the rover on five sols this week.
The Science Team selected two new Planning Targets near the crater rim.
The Tactical Planning Cycle was shortened to 20 hours for the drive on sol 212.

## Planning Notes

Planning Notes are the standard closing section of every weekly report. The Planning Notes list the open actions for the next week and are reviewed in the Monday planning meeting.

- Prepare the drive plan for sol 215.
- Confirm the downlink window with the ground station.
